opportunities.title: Visiting Research Fellowships

amount.raw: UK – up to £600; Europe – up to £700; Rest of world – up to £1,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Academics, curators, artists and senior scholars working on historic or contemporary sculpture, eligible for Visiting Research Fellowships, Artist Research Fellowships, or Senior Fellowships; applicants may be from the UK or internationally.
opportunities.summary: Fellowships enable researchers and artists to spend a month using the Henry Moore Institute or Studios & Gardens facilities, providing accommodation, travel and subsistence expenses.
